description: React component for a task menu with actions like mark as done, pin, duplicate, read aloud, share, edit, delete, and responsive UI handling.

methods.name: redirectToTaskDetails
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of the selected task.

methods.name: handleMarkAsDone
methods.description: Toggles the 'done' status of the selected task and shows a toast if all tasks are completed.

methods.name: handlePin
methods.description: Toggles the 'pinned' status of the selected task.

methods.name: handleDuplicateTask
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the selected task with a new ID and adds it to the task list.

methods.name: handleReadAloud
methods.description: Uses SpeechSynthesis API to read task details aloud, with controls for pause, resume, and cancel.
